children: Ericsson signed a four-year agreement to upgrade ~85% of Nex-Tech Wireless’ RAN in rural Kansas, deploy a cloud-native 5G SA Core, and enable hosting capabilities for other operators.
Multi-year contract adds predictable revenue visibility for Ericsson.
Large scope signals meaningful deployment volume and hardware/software pull-through.
Drives higher-value core software and services revenue for Ericsson.
Opens potential incremental revenue via network sharing/roaming.
Supports premium features; can lift ASPs and margins on RAN gear.

This extends prior collaboration and fits Ericsson’s push into regional U.S. carriers adopting 5G SA. A larger catalyst would be disclosed contract value, rollout pace, or similar wins with additional regional operators.
